versions.name: Fetch config bundle into the workspace
versions.description: Download a configuration bundle (tar.gz) into the workspace and unpack it — typically a presigned object-storage URL (OSS / S3 / MinIO / R2). Pair with the `config.render` block on later steps (render-only mode) to render env files. Requires curl and tar on the Runner host.
versions.description_zh: 下载配置包（tar.gz）到工作区并解包——通常使用对象存储的预签名 URL（OSS / S3 / MinIO / R2 通用）。后续步骤配合 config.render（render-only 模式）渲染 env 文件。需要 Runner 主机装有 curl 和 tar。
versions.author: buz maintainers

versions.name: Fetch config bundle into the workspace
versions.description: Download a configuration bundle (tar.gz) and unpack it from a presigned object-storage URL (OSS / S3 / MinIO / R2), with optional HTTP Basic or header-based authentication. Dual engine: shell unpacks into the Runner workspace; engine: ssh (set `host:`) unpacks into an absolute directory on each target host. Pair with the `config.render` block on later steps (render-only mode). Requires curl and tar where it runs.
versions.description_zh: 下载配置包（tar.gz）到工作区并解包——通常使用对象存储的预签名 URL（OSS / S3 / MinIO / R2 通用）。后续步骤配合 config.render（render-only 模式）渲染 env 文件。需要 Runner 主机装有 curl 和 tar。
